slides.head: Every woman should have something she can call her own.
body: A skill. A career. A business. Something that gives her the opportunity to earn.

slides.head: There's nothing wrong with being supported.
body: By your parents, your partner, your husband, or anyone who genuinely cares about you.
Having people who support you is a beautiful thing.
!But you should also be intentional about building something for yourself.

slides.head: Because life can change.
body: Someone who supports you today might not be in a position to do so tomorrow.
Not because they stopped caring, but because circumstances change.
!And when that happens, you should have something you can fall back on.

slides.head: You don't have to wait until you need money to learn how to earn it.
body: Don't wait until things become difficult before you start developing yourself.
!The best time to build your skills is when you have the opportunity to learn.

slides.head: Your ability to earn gives you options.
list: The option to take care of some of your needs.
The option to contribute at home.
The option to pursue opportunities without depending entirely on someone else.
body: !And sometimes, simply the confidence of knowing you can do something for yourself.

slides.head: You don't need to have everything figured out.
body: You can start with one skill.
Learn it properly. Practise. Build experience.
You might not earn much immediately, and that's okay.
!What matters is that you're developing something valuable.

slides.head: And please, don't think it's too late to start.
body: Whether you're a student, a graduate, employed, unemployed, married, or still trying to figure out your next step.
There's always room to learn something new.
!Start with what you have access to and build from there.

slides.head: Being financially independent doesn't mean doing everything alone.
list: You can receive support and still earn your own money.
You can be married and still have a career.
You can be cared for and still have personal goals.
body: !One doesn't have to cancel the other.

slides.head: Invest in the woman you're becoming.
list: Start small if you need to.
body: !Just don't stop investing in yourself.

slides.head: Don't limit your future to what someone else can provide.
body: There's so much you can learn, build, and become.
Your journey can start with one skill.
slides.question: What skill would you encourage every young woman to learn?

caption:
Support is a gift. Building something of your own is a choice you can make alongside it, whatever stage you're at.

What skill would you encourage every young woman to learn? Tell us in the comments.
